$description: Spacing, radius, border-width, and opacity tokens extracted from Figma 'Wick 3 Foundations' (Layout, Radii, Border, Opacity pages).
$note: Opacity levels 0-100 are defined as named tokens (opacity-0 ... opacity-100) on the Opacity page in Figma; only the scale structure was confirmed, values shown are the standard 0-1 mapping implied by the 10-step naming. The Elevation page defines z-index and shadow tokens (shadow/none, shadow/sm, shadow/base, shadow/lg) referenced by radius/border tokens above but their numeric shadow/blur values were not extracted in this pass.
